'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***Russia said its [[Russian Armed Forces|armed forces]] captured the village of [[Novoselivka Persha]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/russia-says-captured-another-eastern-ukraine-village/articleshow/112264965.cms (''Times of India'')]

***[[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] announces that the country has received its first [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]] [[fighter aircraft]] from [[NATO]] allies. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/08/04/world/europe/ukraine-f-16-fighter-jets.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**[[Non-cooperation movement (2024)|Non-cooperation movement]]
***At least 91 people are killed in violent clashes between anti-government protesters and police units across [[Bangladesh]], as protestors call for [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|Prime Minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] to resign. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/4/more-than-20-killed-as-bangladesh-protesters-renew-call-for-hasina-to-quit (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two people are killed and two others are injured in a stabbing spree in [[Holon]], [[Israel]]. The [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] perpetrator is subsequently shot and killed by [[Israel Police|Israeli police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-kills-woman-wounds-three-stabbing-attack-israel-2024-08-04/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****At least four people are killed and 18 others are injured in an [[Israel]]i strike on the [[Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital|al-Aqsa Hospital]] in [[Deir al-Balah]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://apnews.com/video/israel-hamas-war-fires-gaza-30ef1765d20f48478f0ca9d5ffca58d8 (AP)]

[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/4/israels-war-on-gaza-live-body-parts-everywhere-as-israel-bombs-shelter/ (Al Jazeera)] 
***IDF strikes Hezbollah targets in [[Marjayoun]], [[Hula, Lebanon|Hula]] and [[Zibqin]], starts a fire in a power station in [[Taybeh (Marjaayoun)|Taybeh]] and an IDF drone misses its target of a motorcyclist in [[Rab El Thalathine]] in southern Lebanon. '''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Ukraine]], [[Foreign relations of Mali]]
**[[Mali]] cuts all diplomatic relations with [[Ukraine]] for providing intelligence to [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] [[Strategic Framework for the Defense of the People of Azawad|rebels]] that enabled them to [[Battle of Tinzaouaten (2024)|ambush and kill]] large numbers of [[Wagner Group]] [[Wagner Group activities in Africa|mercenaries]] and [[Malian Armed Forces|Malian troops]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/04/africa/mali-ukraine-wagner-intelligence-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Malaysia–United Kingdom relations]], [[2024 United Kingdom riots]]
**[[Malaysia]] issues a [[travel warning]] urging its citizens to not visit the [[United Kingdom]] due to ongoing violent riots. [https://uk.news.yahoo.com/not-visit-uk-travel-alert-170827441.html?guccounter=1 (Yahoo! UK)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 United Kingdom riots]], [[2024 Southport stabbing]]
**More than 150 people are arrested following violent [[Far-right politics in the United Kingdom|far-right]] riots targeting [[mosque]]s and [[Modern immigration to the United Kingdom|migrant]] infrastructure throughout the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpwddpzyxpzo (BBC)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Tennis at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Novak Djokovic]] defeats [[Carlos Alcaraz]] in the [[Tennis at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|Men's singles]] final to win the Olympic gold medal, becoming the third male player to achieve a singles [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Golden Slam|Career Golden Slam]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/olympics/articles/cjk33v1n8n4o (BBC News)]
***[[Sara Errani]] and [[Jasmine Paolini]] win the gold medal in the [[Tennis at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's doubles|Women's doubles tournament]], earning [[Italy at the Olympics|Italy]] its first gold medal in the [[Tennis at the Olympics|sport]] and making Errani the oldest tennis player to achieve a Career Golden Slam. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/sport/italys-errani-and-paolini-win-womens-doubles-gold-4526096 (CNA)]
**[[Algeria at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Kaylia Nemour]] wins the gold medal in the [[Gymnastics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's uneven bars|Women's uneven bars]], the first gold medal in [[Gymnastics at the Olympics|gymnastics]] for [[Algeria]]. [https://www.npr.org/2024/08/04/g-s1-15298/kaylia-nemour-suni-lee-gold-bronze-uneven-bars-final-paris (NPR)]
**[[Cape Verde at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Daniel Varela de Pina]] wins a bronze medal in [[Boxing at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's 51 kg|Men's flyweight boxing]], earning [[Cape Verde]] its [[Cape Verde at the Olympics|first ever]] Olympic medal. [https://olympics.com/en/news/paris-2024-boxing-yunior-alcantara-david-de-pina-win-bronze (Olympics)]
